page.overview:
Who is Demedan Baumbauch?

is a business owner of the Baumbauch Family Brewery in Trostenwald. He has not yet appeared on Critical Role.

In their pre-stream Session 0 organized by the DM Matthew Mercer, Beauregard Lionett, Fjord, and Jester Lavorre took a job moving boxes for Baumbauch Brewing in Trostenwald. Something happened during the job that caused Beau to form a grudge against them. Beau said in they kind of swindled their employee, and the three companions didn't leave in the best of terms after that.

Beau convinced a courier in Trostenwald to give her three packages meant for the Baumbauch family.

Beau shows Jester the coded letter to Demedan from The Gentleman. She believes the code means the Baumbauch family is ordering a plant called bloodroot (which can be used as poison) from someone called "The Gentleman". Jester agrees with Beau's doodle on the note calling Demedan a douche.
